summary: Advance one bounded research loop to audit practical memory evidence against simple baselines.
objective: Find the best practical agent-memory management possible, including approaches beyond skills and Markdown files. Treat superiority as an empirical question: simple baselines may win. Your orchestration documents are in orchestration/HANDOFF.md. Continue where the manager left off. The first seven days are research only: discover, read, compare and document; no implementation, installations or code execution.
content: The manager should inspect up to four primary sources on practical agent-memory systems, focusing exclusively on whether they demonstrate benefits over comparable Markdown, transcript, or full-history baselines. This continues the prior loop while directly addressing its audit gaps: exact queries, per-query outcomes, precise inspected sections, and an explicit stopping rule. The work remains research-only and must not install, execute, implement, or imply reproduced results.
nextTask: Inspect up to four primary sources on practical agent-memory systems or methods. For each, record the canonical HTTPS link, exact sections inspected, storage model, write/update policy, retrieval method, forgetting or contradiction handling, comparison baseline, budget comparability, and author-reported evidence. Separate author claims from inference and note limitations. Record every search query and outcome, then stop using a stated auditable rule (for example, four eligible sources or exhaustion of a narrowly defined query set). Research and documentation only: no installation, code execution, implementation, or result reproduction.
